data.title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe - Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 20 min | Total Time: 35 min | Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus more for brushing
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  5. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  6. Gently fold in blueberries, being careful not to overmix.
  7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush tops with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep all ingredients cold and handle the dough minimally. If using frozen blueberries, do not thaw before adding to prevent bleeding.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

### **Classic Blueberry Scones**
*   **Prep time:** 15 minutes
*   **Cook time:** 20 minutes
*   **Servings:** 8

**Ingredients:**
*   2 cups all-purpose flour
*   1/4 cup granulated sugar
*   1 tablespoon baking powder
*   1/2 teaspoon salt
*   1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
*   1/2 cup heavy cream
*   1 large egg
*   1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*   1 cup fresh blueberries
*   2 tablespoons turbinado sugar (for sprinkling)

**Instructions:**
1.  Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2.  Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3.  Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4.  In a separate bowl, whisk the cream, egg, and vanilla.
5.  Combine wet and dry ingredients, then gently fold in the blueberries.
6.  On a floured surface, pat the dough into a 1-inch thick circle and cut into 8 wedges.
7.  Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool on a wire rack.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
Turn dough onto floured surface, pat into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
Place wedges on baking sheet, sprinkle with turbinado sugar, and bake for 18-22 minutes until golden.

  7. Place scones on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-22 minutes, until golden brown.
  8. Let cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with glaze.

data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!

data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 18 min | Total Time: 33 min | Yield: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream, cold
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • For the glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar, 2-3 tablespoons milk

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  5. Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, stirring gently until just combined.
  6. Fold in blueberries carefully.
  7. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place scones on prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly, then drizzle with glaze if desired.

Tips

  • Keep all ingredients cold for flakier scones.
  • Do not overmix the dough.
  • Can substitute frozen blueberries (do not thaw).

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - The Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - The Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - The Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!

© 2026 The Coded Culinary. All rights reserved.
